notes: Manufacturer product page (includes a labeled rear/side I/O diagram "Universal-IO-1.png" confirming physical port layout) — page currently carries an "end of life, superseded by XMP-8552/8550" banner but the full spec table and port diagram remain published. Kiosk-processor/4K media player, desktop/embedded form factor (143.6 x 128.13 x 33.65 mm) — no rack mounting, rackUnits omitted. Also has built-in 802.11 b/g/n (2.4GHz) Wi-Fi (no physical connector) and a Micro SD card slot + Kensington lock, which aren't included as ports since no matching connector id exists in the given list. Power is supplied by an external 100-240V AC adapter brick (12V/1.5A output) — the unit itself only exposes the DC barrel input ("DC in" on the diagram); no AC inlet is on the device itself. The rear Micro-USB port is labeled "ADB" (Android Debug Bridge) on the diagram — direction set bidirectional like other USB, but its USB speed/version is not stated in the spec so grade was omitted (the two front USB-A ports are explicitly "USB 2.0 x 2", so those got grade usb-2.0). S/PDIF port shape in the diagram matches an optical Toslink port (grouped with "S/PDIF out" in the spec, no coax/RCA shown). HDMI is output-only (media player, no video-in capability listed).
